note: eleven_v4, one take per line in voice/el/mp3/<take>.mp3. The 60-second cut uses takes 01 02 04 05 22 23 15 16 18 21.
lines: [cold, calm, synthetic system voice] Your Adobe Creative Cloud subscription has been cancelled.
[groggy, just woke up, then alarmed] What? I didn't cancel anything.
[flat, quick, each name clipped] Canva. CapCut. Mailchimp. Hootsuite. Linktree. Notion. ChatGPT. Cancelled.
[cold, final] Every paid app on this account is locked. For thirty days.
[panicked whisper, to herself] My launch is in thirty days.
[casual, amused, leaning on the doorframe] You know you can replace all of that... for free, right?
[confident, a small smile] Open source. Watch.
[delighted, surprised at herself] The teaser's done. And it cost me nothing.
[frustrated, desperate] Ten thousand subscribers... and I can't email a single one.
[calm, reassuring] Listmonk. Your list, on your own server. Nobody can lock you out again.
[proud, energized] Posts scheduled. Plan's back. And my bill is almost zero.
[exhausted, stressed, late at night] Launch is tomorrow, and I still have to write everything. Without ChatGPT.
[panicking] No. No, no, no. The internet's gone.
[calm, steady] Then run your own AI. Right here, on your laptop.
[amazed whisper] No internet... and it's still writing.
[grinning, teasing] So what did all of this cost you?
[proud, a short laugh] Zero. Not one subscription.
[cold, synthetic] Your subscriptions are available again. Resubscribe?
[warm, friendly, to the viewer] Want my whole stack? Follow next level social, and comment STACK.
[casual, amused, confident] Relax. There's a free, open-source tool for every single one.
[exhausted, stressed] Launch is tomorrow. No ChatGPT... [panicking] and now the internet's gone.
